bug_semantics: The bundled MCP server (packages/mcp-server/src/http-server.ts) serves its HTML page with the raw, unvalidated `mcp` query parameter: the route handler reads `const sessionId = url.searchParams.get("mcp") || ""` and calls `res.end(getHtmlPage(sessionId))`, and getHtmlPage interpolates it directly into the inline script as `const sessionId = "${sessionId}"` (plus the <title> interpolation `${sessionId || "No Session"}`). An attacker-crafted URL like https://host:port/?mcp=");alert(document.cookie)// makes the user-controlled string break out of the JS string literal and execute arbitrary JavaScript in the localhost origin of the MCP server — exfiltrating diagram sessions, exported SVG/XML state, and API data (reflected XSS, CWE-79). No HTML/JS escaping is applied anywhere between query parameter and template.
